2.1, motherboard hardware specifications

| Motherboard size | Micro ATX(170*170mm) |

##### 2.2. Rear interface of the motherboard

A: Rear 4x USB2.0 interface 
Support up to theoretical 480Mb speed transfer, backward compatible with the USB1.1 standard, for 
connecting USB TYPE A devices. 

B: HDMI port HDMI1.4 port, up to 4096x2160@30Hz resolution, used to connect to the HDMI display port.

C: DP port DP1.2 port, up to 4096x2160@60Hz resolution, used to connect to the DP display port.

D: USB3.2 GEN2x2 Type-C interface 
Supports up to theoretical 20Gb speed transfers and is backward compatible with the USB2.0 standard for 
connecting USB TYPE C devices. 

4 / 10

F: Dual layer USB3.2 GEN1 interface 
Supports up to theoretical 5Gb speed transfers and is backward compatible with the USB2.0 standard for 
connecting USB TYPE A devices. 
G: RJ45 port 
Network cable interface, used to access the network cable to connect the host system to the network, maximum 
bandwidth 2500Mbps. 

Running indicator No data transfer destroy Data in transit Flicker

| Connection bandwidth indicator | |
| --- | --- |
| Bandwidth | Light State |
| Unconnected | destroy |
| 10Mbps | Steady green |
| 100Mbps | Steady green |
| 1000Mbps | Steady orange |
| 2500Mbps | Steady orange |

H: WI-FI antenna interface (outside screw inside pin) WI-FI wireless network card antenna male interface, onboard AX211 Wi-Fi 6E wireless network card, you can install the complimentary WIFI antenna here.

I: Clear_CMOS button It is used to restore the default Bios status. After the power is powered off, tap 1-3S.

E1: Audio-in port (blue) Used to receive audio input devices, such as mobile phone audio inputs.

E2: Audio-out interface (light green) Used to access audio output devices, such as headphones, speakers and other external devices.

E3: Audio- Microphone interface (pink) For accessing audio input devices, such as radio devices such as microphones.

# MS-Terminator B760ITX D4 WIFI V3

- CHIPSET
- INTEL B760

- CPU
- Supports 12th/13th Gen Intel® Core™ Processors, Pentium® Gold and Celeron® Processors LGA 1700

- MEMORY
- 2x DDR4, Maximum Memory Capacity 64GB Memory Support DDR4 5333(O.C.) / 5133(O.C.) / 5000(O.C.) / 4933(O.C.) / 4800(O.C.) / 4700(O.C.) / 4600(O.C.) / 4500(O.C.) / 4400(O.C.) / 4300(O.C.) / 4266(O.C.) / 4133(O.C.) / 4000(O.C.) / 3866(O.C.) / 3800(O.C.) / 3733(O.C.) / 3666(O.C.) / 3600(O.C.) / 3200 / 3000 / 2933 / 2666 / 2400 / 2133 MHz Supports Intel® XMP 2.0 OC Supports Dual-Controller Dual-Channel mode

- ONBOARD GRAPHICS
- 1x DisplayPort 1.4 1x HDMI™port *HDMI™ port supports up to 4K@30Hz *Graphics specifications may vary between CPU types. Please refer to www.intel.com for any updates.

- EXPANSION SLOT
- 1x PCIe 5.0 x16 slot

- STORAGE
- M.2_1 slot (Key M), type 2280 (supports PCIe 4.0 x4 mode) M.2_2 slot (Key M), type 2280 (supports PCIe 4.0 x4 mode) 4 x SATA 6Gb/s ports

- RAID
- Supports RAID 0, RAID 1, RAID 5 and RAID 10 for SATA storage devices

- USB
- *Front USB (Total 5 ports) 1x USB 3.2 Gen1 Type C 2x USB 3.2 Gen1 Type A 2x USB 2.0 *Rear USB (Total 9 ports) 1x USB 3.2 Gen1 Type C 4x USB 3.2 Gen1 Type A 4x USB 2.0

- LAN
- Realtek® RTL8125BG 2.5G LAN

- WIRELESS / BLUETOOTH
- Intel® Wi-Fi 6E AX211 The Wireless module is pre-installed in the M.2 (Key-E) slot Supports MU-MIMO TX/RX, 2.4GHz / 5GHz / 6GHz* (160MHz) up to 2.4Gbps Supports 802.11 a/ b/ g/ n/ ac/ ax Supports Bluetooth® 5.3

- AUDIO
- Realtek® ALC897 Codec 5.1-Channel High Definition Audio

- INTERNAL I/O
- 1x 24-pin Power Connector(ATX_PWR) 1x 8-pin Power Connector(CPU_PWR) 1x CPU Fan 1x PUMP Fan 2x System Fan 2 x M.2 slots (Key-M) 4x SATA 6Gb/s ports 1x CLR_CMOS 1x 4-Pin BUZZER 1x Front Audio 1x COM Port 1x 9-Pin JDEBUG 1x TPM pin header(Support TPM 2.0) 1x 3-Pin SPDIF

- LED FEATURE
- 4x Distributed Debug LED

- OPERATING SYSTEM
- Support for Windows® 11 64-bit, Windows® 10 64-bit

- FORM FACTOR
- ITX 170mm x 170mm
